subject: ela
intro: An opinion piece shares what you think about a topic and gives reasons to support your thinking. A strong opinion piece has three parts: a topic sentence that states your opinion, one or more reasons that explain why you feel that way, and a closing sentence that wraps up your thinking. Linking words like 'because,' 'and,' and 'also' connect your opinion to your reasons.

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece about whether dogs or cats make better pets. Include a topic sentence, one reason, and a closing sentence.

steps: Step 1: Decide on your opinion. I think dogs make better pets.
Step 2: Write a topic sentence that states the opinion clearly: 'I think dogs make the best pets.'
Step 3: Add a reason using a linking word like 'because': 'Dogs are fun because they love to play and go for walks with you.'
Step 4: Write a closing sentence that restates the opinion: 'That is why I believe dogs are wonderful pets.'
Step 5: Check that all three parts are present: topic sentence, reason, closing sentence.
solution.answer: I think dogs make the best pets. Dogs are fun because they love to play and go for walks with you. That is why I believe dogs are wonderful pets.

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece about whether summer or winter is the better season. State your opinion, give two reasons, and end with a closing sentence.

steps: Step 1: Pick a season and stick with it. I choose summer.
Step 2: Write a topic sentence: 'I think summer is the best season of the year.'
Step 3: Give the first reason: 'First, summer is great because there is no school and I can play outside all day.'
Step 4: Add a second reason using 'also': 'Also, summer is wonderful because I get to go swimming at the pool.'
Step 5: Write a closing sentence: 'For these reasons, summer will always be my favorite season.'
solution.answer: I think summer is the best season of the year. First, summer is great because there is no school and I can play outside all day. Also, summer is wonderful because I get to go swimming at the pool. For these reasons, summer will always be my favorite season.

items.prompt: A student wrote this opinion: 'I think recess should be longer.' Help write the full opinion piece with two reasons and a closing sentence.

steps: Step 1: Use the given opinion as the topic sentence: 'I think recess should be longer.'
Step 2: Add a first reason: 'Running and playing helps students stay healthy and have more energy for class.'
Step 3: Add a second reason with 'also': 'Also, longer recess gives friends more time to talk and play together.'
Step 4: Write a closing sentence that restates the main idea: 'That is why our school should give students more time for recess.'
solution.answer: I think recess should be longer. Running and playing helps students stay healthy and have more energy for class. Also, longer recess gives friends more time to talk and play together. That is why our school should give students more time for recess.

items.prompt:
Read the weak opinion piece below. Explain what is missing and write an improved version.

Weak piece: 'Pizza is good. I like it.'

steps: Step 1: Identify the problems. There is no linking word, no clear reason, and no closing sentence.
Step 2: Rewrite the topic sentence more clearly: 'I think pizza is the best food for lunch.'
Step 3: Add a reason with a linking word: 'I love pizza because it has delicious cheese and many topping choices.'
Step 4: Add a closing sentence: 'That is why pizza should be on the menu every day.'
solution.answer: I think pizza is the best food for lunch. I love pizza because it has delicious cheese and many topping choices. That is why pizza should be on the menu every day.

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece about whether reading or playing outside is the better after-school activity. Include an opinion, two reasons using linking words, and a closing statement.

steps: Step 1: Choose your opinion: reading books is the better after-school activity.
Step 2: Write the topic sentence: 'I believe reading is the best thing to do after school.'
Step 3: Add reason one: 'Reading is great because it teaches you new words and takes you to exciting places in your imagination.'
Step 4: Add reason two: 'Also, reading makes you a better writer and helps you do well in school.'
Step 5: Write a closing sentence: 'For all of these reasons, I think every student should read after school.'
solution.answer: I believe reading is the best thing to do after school. Reading is great because it teaches you new words and takes you to exciting places in your imagination. Also, reading makes you a better writer and helps you do well in school. For all of these reasons, I think every student should read after school.

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece about whether apples or bananas are the better fruit. Include a topic sentence, one reason, and a closing sentence.
items.hint: Start by choosing your favorite fruit and writing 'I think ___ is the better fruit.' Then add a 'because' sentence.

steps: State your opinion clearly in the first sentence.
Give one reason using 'because' or 'since.'
End with a closing sentence that restates your opinion.
solution.answer: I think apples are the better fruit. Apples are great because they are crunchy, sweet, and come in many different colors. That is why apples are my favorite snack.

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece about whether your school should have a class pet. Give your opinion, two reasons, and a closing sentence.
items.hint: Decide if you are for or against a class pet. Use 'because' for your first reason and 'also' for your second.

steps: Write a clear topic sentence stating your opinion.
Give reason one using 'because.'
Give reason two using 'also.'
Close with a sentence restating your opinion.
solution.answer: I think our class should have a pet. A class pet would be a great idea because students would learn how to care for animals. Also, having a pet would make our classroom a more fun and exciting place to be. That is why I believe every classroom should have a pet.

items.prompt: A student wrote: 'Art class is my favorite. It is fun.' Rewrite this as a complete opinion piece with a topic sentence, two reasons, and a closing sentence.
items.hint: Keep the idea about art class but add reasons and a closing. Think about WHY art class is fun.

steps: Improve the topic sentence to be more specific.
Add two reasons explaining why art class is the favorite.
End with a closing sentence.
solution.answer: I think art class is the best class in school. Art is wonderful because I get to be creative and make things with my own hands. Also, art class is great because there are no wrong answers — every project is special. That is why art should be a part of every school day.

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece about whether students should be allowed to listen to music while they do homework. State your opinion, give two reasons using linking words, and end with a closing statement.
items.hint: Pick a side and stick with it. You can say yes or no. Use 'because' and 'also' to link your reasons.

steps: Choose one side of the argument.
State the opinion in a clear topic sentence.
Give two reasons using linking words.
Write a closing sentence.
solution.answer: I think students should be allowed to listen to music while they do homework. Music helps because it makes homework feel less boring and keeps students from getting distracted. Also, some students think better because soft music helps them focus on their work. For these reasons, I believe music and homework are a great combination.

items.prompt: Write a complete opinion piece about whether your school should have longer lunch breaks. Include a topic sentence, two reasons with linking words, and a closing sentence.
items.hint: Your topic sentence should clearly say what you think. Your reasons should explain WHY longer lunch would be good or bad.

steps: Write a strong topic sentence with your opinion.
Reason 1: use 'because' to connect your opinion to the reason.
Reason 2: use 'also' to add another reason.
Closing sentence: wrap up your opinion.
solution.answer: I believe our school should have a longer lunch break. A longer lunch is important because students need enough time to eat their food and not feel rushed. Also, extra time at lunch is great because friends can talk and relax before going back to class. That is why I think a longer lunch break would make our school day better for everyone.
